scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sazonov/site build && node scripts/budget.mjs && pnpm --filter @sazonov/printor build && pnpm --filter @sazonov/glyph-art build && node scripts/nest-tools.mjs
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @sazonov/site lint && pnpm --filter @sazonov/printor lint && pnpm --filter @sazonov/glyph-art lint
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @sazonov/printor test && pnpm --filter @sazonov/glyph-art test
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test
